title: Feature Pipeline Skill
description: Enforces the development process from Inbox to Done — ensuring PRD creation, stage gates, and review approvals are never skipped.

userStories.title: Follow feature pipeline precisely
userStories.description: As Bill, I want Zak to follow the feature pipeline precisely so that no steps are skipped
acceptanceCriteria: Explore & Plan mode clearly defines DO and DO NOT actions
Execute mode clearly defines DO and DO NOT actions
Await Approval mode clearly defines DO and DO NOT actions
Deploy & Close mode clearly defines DO and DO NOT actions
userStories.notes: SKILL.md created with all 5 modes documented including explicit DO/DO NOT lists

userStories.title: PRD JSON for every In Progress card

userStories.title: Enforce stage gates
